title: 第19章朱竹清的守护，宁风致求我管教荣荣-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    朱竹清、小舞等人，惊声大喊，脸上挂满了惊慌之色。

    尤其是朱竹清，脸色都白了。

    若是叶寒死了，她的依靠也就没了。

    吭！

    突然，一声龙吟响彻天地。

    只见叶寒在生死危机之下，右拳紧握，调动全身魂力、杀气，轰出蕴含着一丝祖龙之力的杀拳。

    此拳一出，威势惊人，硬是将剑斗罗随手斩出来的剑气击溃。

    但同时，叶寒的拳头也被剑气砍出一道浅浅的剑痕。

    但这道剑痕，仅在一瞬间就恢复了。

    这就是祖龙血脉的厉害，不仅拥有极强的力量和防御力，还拥有极强的恢复力和治愈力。

    “咦？”

    “这小子有点能耐。”

    剑斗罗见叶寒在没有使用武魂的情况下，将他的七杀剑气击溃，脸上闪过一丝惊叹。

    虽然他刚才打出来的剑气声势比较大，但他却做了点小手脚，让威力骤减。

    只要叶寒不是无能之辈，就不会死，最多受点伤。

    毕竟宁风致没有下令，他也不好在这么多人的面前杀人，丢了七宝琉璃宗脸面。

    但如果把事情调查清楚，里面没有误会，就是叶寒单纯的羞辱宁荣荣，那就别怪他直接下杀手了。

    宁风致也注意到了刚才的一幕，双眼直冒精芒。

    可不是什么人都能挡下剑斗罗的剑气。

    眼前的少年看着年纪不大，竟然有如此本事，是一个天才。

    “叶寒大哥，你没事吧。”

    朱竹清见叶寒好像没受伤，有点担忧地跑了过来。

    “没事，是剑前辈刚才手下留情了。”

    “否则，我现在已经是一具尸体。”

    叶寒摆了摆手，在看向剑斗罗的眼神中闪过一丝兴奋。

    刚才那一道剑气，让他感知到剑斗罗在剑道上的感悟很深，而且还是那种杀伐类型的剑道，与他属性很相似。

    若是能与这种强者打一场，有利于他快速成长。

    “多谢剑前辈！”

    赵无极和弗兰德听懂了叶寒的意思，向剑斗罗微微抱拳施礼，以表感激。

    “哼，谁说老夫留手了。”

    “是这小子命大，有点能耐。”

    “既然你没死，那就再吃老夫一剑。”

    剑斗罗可不会直接承认，而是表现出一副继续动手的样子。

    其实，他也好奇，叶寒的能耐到底有多强。

    “剑前辈且慢！”

    “你不能杀他。”

    “当时叶寒大哥扇荣荣耳光的时候，我就在现场，事情不是你们想的那样。”

    “我说句不该说的话，荣荣那时候确实该打。”

    朱竹清见剑斗罗还要动手，不顾自身安危地挡在叶寒的面前，双手轻举，将他护在身后。

    之前，叶寒也是这样保护她的。

    现在该轮到她为叶寒挺身而出了。

    “小丫头，别以为此事跟你无关，你就可以信口开河。”

    “再让我听到你说荣荣的坏话，小心我揍你！”

    剑斗罗有点生气了。

    当着他的面儿说宁荣荣该打，有点过分。

    纵然是宁荣荣的错，也应该委婉一点吧。

    “若是剑前辈想动手，尽管来便是。”

    “我这个人就是这样，认定的事情不会改变。”

    “当时是谁的错，就是谁的错，没有任何人能让我改变事实。”

    朱竹清可不怕剑斗罗的威胁。

    若是剑斗罗非要杀人，她妥协也没用。

    如果剑斗罗没想过杀人，她说出真话又能怎样。

    连真话都不能讲，那才是人生中最大的悲哀。

    “好哇，竟然还敢顶撞老夫。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhu Zhuqing, Xiao Wu and others shouted in shock, their faces full of panic.

Especially Zhu Zhuqing, his face turned pale.

If Ye Han dies, her support will be gone.



Suddenly, a dragon roar resounded throughout the world.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​OUT I see Ye Han clenching his right fist tightly, mobilizing all his soul power and murderous intent, blasting out a killing fist that contained a trace of the power of the ancestral dragon.

The punch was so powerful that it defeated Sword Douluo's casual sword energy.

But at the same time, Ye Han's fist was also cut with a shallow sword mark by the sword energy.

But this sword mark was restored in just an instant.

This is the power of the Ancestral Dragon bloodline. It not only has extremely strong strength and defense, but also has extremely strong recovery and healing power.

"Huh?"

"This guy is quite capable."

Seeing that Ye Han defeated his Seven Kills Sword Qi without using his martial spirit, Sword Douluo felt a flash of surprise on his face.

Although the sword energy he just unleashed was quite powerful, he did some tricks to reduce its power.

As long as Ye Han is not an incompetent person, he will not die, but will be slightly injured at most.

After all, Ning Fengzhi didn’t give the order, so he couldn’t kill someone in front of so many people and lose the face of the Qibao Glazed Sect.

But if the matter is investigated clearly and there is no misunderstanding, and Ye Han simply humiliated Ning Rongrong, then don’t blame him for killing him directly.

Ning Fengzhi also noticed the scene just now, his eyes gleaming.

Not everyone can block Sword Douluo's sword energy.

The boy in front of me looks young, but he has such ability, he is a genius.

"Brother Ye Han, are you okay?"

Seeing that Ye Han seemed uninjured, Zhu Zhuqing ran over worriedly.

"It's okay, Senior Jian was merciful just now."

"Otherwise, I would be a corpse now."

Ye Han waved his hand, and a hint of excitement flashed in his eyes as he looked at Sword Douluo.

The sword energy just now made him feel that Sword Douluo had a deep understanding of the way of the sword, and it was also a killing type of swordsmanship, which had very similar attributes to him.

If he can fight with such a strong person, it will help him grow quickly.

"Thank you, Senior Jian!"

Zhao Wuji and Flender understood what Ye Han meant, and gave Sword Douluo a slight clasped fist salute to express their gratitude.

"Humph, who said I had any chance to keep my hand?"

"This guy is lucky and has some abilities."

"Since you are not dead, then take another blow from me."

Sword Douluo would not admit it directly, but showed a look of continuing to attack.

In fact, he was also curious about how capable Ye Han was.

"Senior Jian, wait a minute!"

"You can't kill him."

"When Brother Ye Han slapped Rongrong, I was at the scene. Things were not what you thought."

"I have to say something that I shouldn't have said. Rongrong really should have been beaten at that time."

Seeing that Sword Douluo was still going to take action, Zhu Zhuqing stood in front of Ye Han regardless of his own safety, and raised his hands lightly to protect him behind him.

Ye Han also protected her in this way before.

Now it was her turn to stand up for Ye Han.

"Little girl, don't think that this matter has nothing to do with you, so you can just talk nonsense."

“If you let me hear you say bad things about Rongrong again, be careful I’ll beat you up!”

Sword Douluo was a little angry.

It was a bit excessive to say that Ning Rongrong should be beaten in front of him.

Even if it was Ning Rongrong’s fault, she should be more tactful.

"If Senior Jian wants to take action, just come."

“That’s just the way I am, and the things I believe will never change.”

"Whoever was at fault at that time is still at fault. No one can make me change the facts."

Zhu Zhuqing is not afraid of Sword Douluo's threat.

If Sword Douluo insists on killing people, there is no point in compromising on her part.

If Sword Douluo never thought about killing people, what would happen if she told the truth.

Not being able to tell the truth is the greatest tragedy in life.

"Wow, you actually dare to contradict me."
